Theorem_B1_Palais_Symmetric_Criticality_.consequence: Stage-1 Z_n-cyclic optimization followed by local Stage-2 L-BFGS from the cyclic critical point measures the exact Z_n-Cyclic Subspace Entanglement Barrier Delta_F^{cyc}(n, D), which obeys the smooth curve eta^{cyc}(8, D) in [0.728, 0.749] for D=3,4,5,6 even when a discrete symmetry-breaking solution exists outside H^{Z_n} (as at D=5).

Theorem_B4_Pure_State_Slicing_and_Haar_S.statement: Any pure AME(8, D) state, when projected on 1 party onto any |v> in C^D, yields an exact pure AME(7, D) state (and spans a pure ((7, D, 4))_D MDS code). Consequently, non-existence of AME(7, 6) implies non-existence of AME(8, 6). Furthermore, for any pure AME(7, D) state, its 1-party slice |phi_v> on 6 parties satisfies the exact Haar-averaged 3-party purity identity E_{|v>}[Tr(rho_S(phi_v)^2)] = 2 / ((D+1) D^2) for all 20 cuts |S|=3.

generalization_audit_10_cells.purpose: Distinguish deductive proof from definition vs post-hoc explanation across n=4..8, D=2..4

Theorem_D1_Dihedral_Reflection_Obstructi.statement: For every n == 0 (mod 4) (k = n/2 even) and every commutative ring R or field F_q, NO symmetric circulant matrix A_{i,j} = a_{|i-j|} can be AME(n, q). Proof from definition: the reflection tau(i) = -i (mod n) has 2 fixed points {0, k} and k-1 swapped pairs. Any tau-invariant cut S of size k containing {0, k} and (k-2)/2 pairs has dim Eig_{-1}(tau|_{S^c}) = k/2 > k/2 - 1 = dim Eig_{-1}(tau|_S). Since A commutes with tau, A_{S, S^c} maps Eig_{-1}(tau|_{S^c}) into Eig_{-1}(tau|_S) and must have kernel dimension >= 1, so det(A_{S, S^c}) == 0 identically.

generalization_audit_10_cells.epistemological_conclusion: For n >= 7, D >= 3 (e.g. AME(7,3), AME(7,4), AME(8,5)), continuous quartic purity optimization (both Z_n-cyclic and unconstrained from Haar seeds) arrests on a universal glassy local-minimum plateau Delta_F^{glass}(n, D) > 0 even when exact Delta_F = 0 solutions exist. Therefore, numerical GPU plateaus > 0 cannot prove non-existence for n >= 7, D >= 3; only algebraic obstructions from definition (like Theorem D1 for circulants at n == 0 mod 4, Rains shadows, or exhaustive discrete C provers like Theorem B3 for stabilizer AME(8,4)) constitute genuine proofs.
